user.title: Select AirTap vent
user.description: Select an AC Infinity fan or controller to configure, or enter its address manually.

manual.title: Connect by Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your AC Infinity device (e.g., A4:C1:38:F6:48:F6).

abort.unsupported_model: The device does not expose a supported AC Infinity notify/write pair, or its advertisement is invalid.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
error.connect_failed: Could not establish a Bluetooth connection. Check the adapter, vent power, and whether another client is connected.
error.disconnect_failed: The Bluetooth session could not be cleanly released. Check the debug log and adapter before retrying.
error.initialization_failed: The vent rejected clock initialization or returned an unexpected clock acknowledgement. No fan or mode changes were sent. Download the debug log.
error.invalid_response: The vent replied, but its mode/speed data is missing or unsupported. Download the debug log.
error.no_response: Connected and sent a command (clock initialization or query), but no valid matching reply arrived after bounded retries. Download the debug log.
error.not_ac_infinity_device: The specified Bluetooth device is not a recognized AC Infinity device.
error.notify_failed: Connected, but subscribing to vent notifications failed. See the debug log for the characteristic and error.
error.service_failed: Connected, but Bluetooth service discovery failed. See the debug log for the discovered services.
error.unsupported_model: The device does not expose a supported AC Infinity notify/write pair, or its advertisement is invalid.
error.write_failed: Connected, but the Bluetooth command could not be written. See the debug log for its write properties.

init.title: AC Infinity Options
init.description: Configure operation modes and polling intervals.

data.passive_only: Passive advertisement mode only (no active GATT connections)
